title.sub: When can a lander at the lunar south pole see the Sun and Earth?

clips.caption: Pick a site and a date. Real LOLA terrain, real Sun and Earth positions (NASA SPICE), time to sunset and Earthset.
It searches up to a year of dates: the soonest landing, the most sunlight, the most Earth contact.
Stand at the site in 3D: the real skyline, the Sun and the shadows through the mission.
Compare sites side by side: Sun and Earth now, time to sunset and Earthset, sunlight on a panel (before panel efficiency).

end.sub: Also: sky chart, landing ellipse, launch-slip check, guided tour. Geometry checked against JPL Horizons (0.04 arcsec).
